summary: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 10.4 Solve Applications Modeled by Quadratic Equations: Solve applications modeled by Quadratic Equations
body: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, section "10.4 Solve Applications Modeled by Quadratic Equations", prints these objectives: "Solve applications modeled by Quadratic Equations". The section text says: "The sum of two consecutive odd numbers is −100 . Find the numbers. If you missed this problem, review Example 3.10 ." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
